tools.name: compute_codice_fiscale
tools.description: Compute the Italian codice fiscale (tax code) of a person from surname, name, sex, birth date and birth place, with the D.M. 23/12/1976 rules. The place can be a comune ('Roma', 'Castro (LE)'), a foreign state ('Francia') or a codice catastale ('H501'); the code valid on the birth date is used. Retu

tools.name: decode_codice_fiscale
tools.description: Read back a codice fiscale: sex, birth date (one or two possible centuries), birth comune or foreign state valid on that date, the consonant codes of surname and name, and omocodia. The full name cannot be recovered from a code. Fails with the reason when the format or the check character is wrong.

tools.name: verify_codice_fiscale
tools.description: Check that a codice fiscale is well formed, layer by layer: format, check character, a real birth date, a place code valid on that date, and optionally the surname and name letters. tools.name: lookup_place
tools.description: Search the 15,000 comuni of every era and the foreign states of the ANPR archive by name or by code (codice catastale like H501, Z-code like Z110). Returns up to 20 places with their province and the dates their code was valid. Give a date to keep only the places valid on it.

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "decode_codice_fiscale" appears informational but accepts parameters (code) that enable code/file/secret access.
